opening.argument: The presentation identifies Samsung Smart Tutor as a remote device-support app and walks viewers through installing it and requesting help with a device issue. Its six-digit PIN and remote-control steps are explained as part of that support process, not as a request for payment or credentials. The guide also states that agents cannot access applications without the user's confirmed permission. These are concrete instructions for activating and using a support service, with a stated limit on access. Nothing in the supplied material presents an investment, payment, credential request, or other deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: To start experiencing remote support from Samsung, you'll firstly need to download and install the Smart Tutor app.
Call Samsung call center, and explain your issue to call agent and request remote support
you can input the six-digit pin code received from the Agents And Click Remote Control
Please do not worry as our agents are unable to access any applications without your permission being confirmed.
